bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
old="sha256:999a9fa61cb476510c60df5afeca6509a077a1c9c5aa820317dd5f5e7660b8c8"
name="deploy-gaybbs-1"
running="$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null || echo absent)"
image="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null || echo absent)"
tag="$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local 2>/dev/null || echo absent)"
cstat="$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Status}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null || echo absent)"
{ printf 'PR47_ROLLBACK_READBACK\nRUNNING=%s\nIMAGE=%s\nTAG_IMAGE=%s\nSTATE=%s\nORIGINAL_IMAGE_MATCH=%s\n' "$running" "$image" "$tag" "$cstat" "$([ "$image" = "$old" ] && echo yes || echo no)"; docker ps --filter name=deploy-gaybbs-1 --format 'SERVICE={{.Names}} STATUS={{.Status}}'; } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
